name: Biển Hồ tea hills
summary: Tea slopes sit about 12 km north of Pleiku on the provincial scenic list, reached from Quốc lộ 14 via Lê Văn Sỹ and the irrigation dam road. Pair the rows with Biển Hồ on the same northern loop. Respect working farms on the paths.
timeNeeded: One to two hours with the lake
getThere: Northern loop from Pleiku with Biển Hồ
